notes: Whether qa-tester/testing-apps record run evidence (a video per happy-path scenario, and a screenshot plus a video per bug). mode: "auto" (default) records and saves every run without asking; "ask" makes the delegating conversation ask the user before each run. Where evidence goes is not set here: it lands in the product's own workDir, under <workDir>/qa-evidence/. An optional "dir" here is only a fallback for runs that match no product config.
